citations.claim: Pole already swung to 0.688 rad at step 18 with high energy, about to violate
First violation: pole angle 0.803 rad exceeds 0.8 limit with energy greatly amplified from noisy control

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.01519 to 0.0 only; same 19 steps. This removes noisy angle/rate feedback that drove destabilizing positive-feedback force, so pole stays upright.

explanation: Seeded sensor noise on theta/omega causes state-feedback controller to apply wrong-direction growing forces (28.7 at step10, 47.2 at step15, saturated 52.2 at steps18-19). Energy pumped from ~1.98 to 34.1 to 40.3 while cart velocity runs away to -8.35 m/s, swinging pole from -0.05 to +0.80 rad. With zero noise the same plant/initial condition stays balanced, showing noise-induced destabilization not plant instability.
vision_note: The blue cart drifts leftward while its pole leans increasingly far to the right across steps 16 to 18. At step 19 the pole tip turns red, showing the pole has swung far from upright into violation.
